patterns: APPSC asks proponent one-liners: continental drift = Wegener (1912); India part of Gondwanaland; number of major plates (7).
Sea-floor spreading trends (crust age/density/thickness increase away from the ridge) and GPS-based plate monitoring are APPSC-tested.
Himalaya-Arakan Yoma earthquakes = Indian-Eurasian collision; tsunami cause = sea-floor fault movement.
Rift-lake trap (Lake Victoria is not a rift lake) and horst = block mountain (Vosges) appear in APPSC Group-1.
App MCQs cover evidences and boundaries well; some add research-news detail (delamination, Ladakh arc) beyond PYQ depth.
